experiment: XF: fresh never-used cities-style truth TEST from geonames; single frozen final pass (GPT-2 Small + Gemma-2-2B)
status: PRE-REGISTERED (frozen after the text-only build and a smoke on GoT cities TRAIN rows; before any fresh DEV or TEST row is embedded)
evidence_level_on_completion: confirmed test result on a pristine TEST split (never tokenised, embedded or scored before the test stage)
research_question: Do the project's representation-preservation findings hold on truth statements no decision has ever touched? (a) Do the public SAEs (res-jb for GPT-2, Gemma Scope 16k canonical for Gemma) preserve linearly decodable city truth at depth-matched layers? (b) Does the truth-subspace-preserving fine-tune (TSP-R L8 TopK; TI-1 L11 TopK, L8 BatchTopK, L8 ReLU) reduce the re-fit truth gap relative to its reconstruction-only control on fresh cities?
why: Audit 2026-11-21 row 23: the GoT cities TEST rows were exposed during GPT-2 method decisions, and TSP-R / TI-1 / TI-4 are VALIDATION-level. XF is the only route to a TEST-level claim for the method and the preservation findings. It connects to the main research question (preserve truth information while keeping reconstruction).

data.source: got-repo/datasets/geonames.csv (GoT upstream; sha256 recorded in build_info.json)
data.construction: places with population in [200k, 500k) (GoT cities.csv uses > 500k), country in the GoT cities country pool (geonames names mapped to GoT strings), ASCII simple name, not a GoT cities / neg_cities name, not a country name, unambiguous (no other-country place >= 10k with the same normalised name), at most 30 cities per country (salted-hash order). One TRUE and one FALSE statement per city with the GoT template 'The city of X is in Y.'; the FALSE country is uniform over the pool minus the true country (seeded).
data.split: city-level salted hash (salt XF-geonames-2026-11-23): DEV 40 % / TEST 60 %. 713 cities: DEV 263 cities (526 statements), TEST 450 cities (900 statements). Labels balanced by construction.
data.leakage_checks: hard asserts in build: 0 statements duplicate any project text (GoT cities, neg_cities, larger_than, smaller_than, RepE facts); 0 city-name overlap with GoT cities / neg_cities (so with every TSP / TI-1 training row and subspace); 0 duplicate statements; 0 cities in both splits; exactly one TRUE + one FALSE per city.

models_sites.gpt2: TransformerLens gpt2-small, blocks.L.hook_resid_pre, BOS + statement, final token (identical to scripts/geometry_of_truth/31 extract). Layers 3/6/9 (public), 8 and 11 (TSP cells).
models_sites.gemma: HF Gemma-2-2B rev c5ebcd40, bf16, eager; output of model.model.layers[L] (resid_post); BOS + statement, final token (as scripts/gemma/10). Layers 5/12/19 (triplet T-B, as XC-3).

saes.public: res-jb (GPT-2 L3/6/9) and Gemma Scope 16k canonical (Gemma L5/12/19)
saes.tsp: every surviving checkpoint of TSP-R L8 TopK (8 seeds x 3 folds; arms base, ctrl, tsp, rand) and TI-1 L11 TopK / L8 BatchTopK / L8 ReLU (3 seeds x 3 folds; arms base, ctrl, tsp, rand), each SHA-256-verified against its ledger. Arms pca/shuf of TSP-R are not evaluated (not part of TI-1 either). TI-2 / TI-4 checkpoints were lost with the old instance's scratch disk and cannot be evaluated.

gate: DEV only, per (model, layer): grouped 3-fold (by city) cross-validated logistic AUROC on ORIGINAL activations (C grid 0.01/0.1/1, best C) >= 0.70 (TSP-R Phase 0 rule). Ineligible cells are not scored on TEST and are reported as not run.
readers: fitted on DEV only, applied to TEST: frozen logistic (fit on DEV original activations, C by grouped CV) and frozen mass-mean (DEV original); refit logistic (fit on DEV SAE reconstructions, C by grouped CV). Original AUROC = frozen logistic on TEST original activations.

metrics.gap: AUROC(original) - AUROC(reconstruction) for the matching reader on TEST (lower is better)
metrics.also_reported: frozen_logistic and frozen_massmean gaps; TEST NMSE of the reconstruction normalised by the between-statement variance of the final-token activations (as TI-1 task_nmse; values > 1 are expected because final-token activations vary little across statements); mean L0 on the fresh rows

uncertainty: city-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20261124, shared across all SAEs. Public SAEs: percentile CI. TSP contrasts: per-seed estimates (fold-averaged, equal weights over the 3 folds; base shared across folds) with tspr_stats.hierarchical (seed + city uncertainty).

criteria.P1_public_preservation: per public cell (6 cells, both models), refit-logistic gap: LOSS if the 95 % CI lower bound > 0; NON-INFERIOR if the CI upper bound < SESOI 0.010; else INCONCLUSIVE. Same labels reported for frozen_logistic.
criteria.P2_tsp_vs_ctrl: per TSP cell (4), contrast tsp - ctrl refit-logistic gap: tspr_stats.h1_label (SESOI 0.010); SUPPORTED if the label starts with SUPPORTED and Holm-adjusted p (over the eligible TSP cells) < 0.05
criteria.P2_overall: the TSP effect REPLICATES on fresh TEST if >= 3 of the 4 cells are SUPPORTED and no cell is HARM; it FAILS TO REPLICATE if <= 1 cell is SUPPORTED; otherwise PARTIAL
criteria.secondary: tsp - rand (geometry control), tsp - base, ctrl - base; frozen-logistic versions; cross-model comparison of P1 at matched depth (descriptive only)
criteria.P1_ceiling_rule: if the original-activation TEST AUROC 95 % CI upper bound is >= 0.995, the cell's P1 label is prefixed 'CEILING (uninformative)': with no headroom a zero gap is not evidence of preservation. Added after the TRAIN-only smoke (Gemma L12/L19 AUROC 1.0 on GoT cities TRAIN), before any fresh row is embedded.

predictions_from_validation: TSP-R L8 TopK tsp - ctrl = -0.0207 (VALIDATION, 8 seeds); TI-1: SUPPORTED at 3/3 eligible cells (VALIDATION). XF tests whether these replicate on a different, never-used city population (smaller cities, 200k-500k).
leakage: fresh DEV is used only for the gate and for reader fitting; fresh TEST is embedded and scored once by the test stage, which refuses unless gate.json is committed and unchanged; all hashes are checked before gate/test/analyze. No TSP / TI-1 SAE was trained or selected on any fresh row.
smoke: GoT cities TRAIN rows only (half of TRAIN cities, split into pseudo-DEV / pseudo-TEST by city), 2 seeds per TSP cell; checks the extraction, readers, bootstrap and analysis code paths. Not evidence.
test_data_used: gate: none; test: fresh TEST once
runtime_estimate: gate ~3 min; test ~20-30 min (about 220 SAEs x readers on CPU)
smoke_findings: smoke/ (GoT cities TRAIN only, 2 seeds per TSP cell, 85 SAEs): pipeline runs end to end; GPT-2 L3 fails the 0.70 gate on TRAIN (0.65); Gemma L12/L19 at AUROC 1.0 (ceiling rule added); TI-1 L8 ReLU fine-tunes have GoT-row L0 ~250 vs base 83 (known from TI-1: L0 is matched on OWT, not on GoT). Smoke numbers are not evidence and no criterion was set from them other than the ceiling rule.
